entities.name: Karib'il Watar I.
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Karibʾīl Watār Yahanʾm, sometimes distinguished as Karib'il Watar II, was probably the most important ruler of early Saba. He is sometimes regarded as the founder of the kingdom proper, as he was responsible for changing the ruler's title from mukarrib to malik.
